record.label: Weights-based streaming tracker (goal-class)
record.summary: The only evidence-open path to raw <1e-8: propagate the chaos state (m, a, M + compressed H3/H4) from the weights themselves - exact and identification-free through L2, engines certified at 0.1% - past the depth-transport wall to mid-depth, producing per-layer pair-field supply at corr ~0.8+ (vs today's 0.2 parity ceiling from carried planes, which are information-limited: proven). Components all certified: resolvent emissions, Wick assemblies, shared-basis carry economics (R~n/2, mixing-closed), the three numerics laws, R-field targets banked at 1e-5 truth both nets. 2026-09-01 measurement (T-16): the tracker's STANDALONE supply is worth ~0 through the real consumption (per-layer corr 0.19-0.36 vs the chain's 0.50-0.79; accumulation scale grows 28x with depth; +0.4% at best with in-sample per-layer rescale). Parked behind the package sub-problems; its assimilation machinery stays available.
record.terminal_criterion: Preregistered gates in LANE_g3_tracker.md: (T1) depth-transport prototype reaches L5 with pair-field C/K21 supply corr >=0.6 vs banked R-fields on rank35; (T2) frozen replication on rank100 same-sign within 30%; (T3) consumption value >=+8% raw only_v on both nets; any gate fail -> record the wall honestly and re-derive.
record.goal_path_summary: Compute what the estimator should have known from the network's own weights, layer by layer, instead of reconstructing it from the estimator's own summaries (which provably lack the needed information). The shallow layers are already exact; the build extends that exactness deeper with a compressed carried state. If its accuracy holds to mid-depth, the variance supply reaches the quality the 1.25-1.46e-8 oracle prices, and with the mean channel riding along, the sub-1e-8 goal is in range. Measured 2026-09-01: on its own it is not yet worth anything to the final answer; parked while the cheaper route is tested.
